officials.name: Amy Aguirre
officials.address: 316 N. 26th Street Council Chambers, 5th Floor Billings, MT 59101
officials.bio: Amy Aguirre was born and raised in Billings and holds a BA in psychology. She is the Executive Director of Angela's Piazza: Women's Drop-In Center, with a career focused on the nonprofit sector. She aims to work with Council on public safety, affordable housing, and protecting green spaces.

officials.name: Andrew Lindley
officials.address: 316 N. 26th Street Council Chambers, 5th Floor Billings, MT 59101
officials.bio: Andrew Lindley is a technology executive and civic leader with over 20 years of experience in IT, cybersecurity, and leadership. He brings a data-driven perspective to city governance, focusing on public safety, transparency, and fiscal responsibility. A longtime Billings resident, he is committed to strengthening neighborhoods and ensuring accessible, accountable city government.

officials.name: Bill Kennedy
officials.address: 316 N. 26th Street Council Chambers, 5th Floor Billings, MT 59101

officials.name: Denis Pitman
officials.address: 316 N. 26th Street Council Chambers, 5th Floor Billings, MT 59101
officials.bio: Denis Pitman was born in Butte, MT, and grew up in Billings Heights, graduating from Billings Senior in 1984. He holds a BA in Liberal Arts and Behavioral Science and an Associate of Applied Science in Mortuary Science, working as a licensed mortician since 1992. With a lifetime of public service, including serving on city, county, and state boards, he is currently a City Councilman for Ward 2 and looks forward to building a better Billings.

officials.name: Kendra Shaw
officials.address: 316 N. 26th Street Council Chambers, 5th Floor Billings, MT 59101
officials.bio: Kendra Shaw grew up in Billings and moved back years ago to raise her family. A graduate of the University of Montana, she holds an MFA from the University of Michigan and is currently a freelance copy and grant writer. She hopes to help shape Billings into a city her girls want to return to as adults.

officials.name: Mark Nicholson
officials.address: 316 N. 26th Street Council Chambers, 5th Floor Billings, MT 59101
officials.bio: Dr. Mark Nicholson, a Montana native, moved to Billings in 2004. He holds degrees from Carroll College and the University of Washington School of Medicine, with training in family medicine and psychiatry, and practiced psychiatry for many years. As the Council Member for Ward 1, he focuses on increasing housing, reducing crime, and improving street safety.

officials.name: Mike Boyett
officials.address: 316 N. 26th Street Council Chambers, 5th Floor Billings, MT 59101
officials.bio: Mike Boyett was raised in Billings, graduated from Eastern Montana College, and served in the Air Force. He worked for the Yellowstone County Sheriff's Department and later retired from First Interstate Bank as Vice President and Corporate Security Officer. He has also held various volunteer positions including Billings Police Commissioner and Zoning Commissioner.

officials.name: Roy Neese
officials.address: 316 N. 26th Street Council Chambers, 5th Floor Billings, MT 59101
officials.bio: My desire is to help shape the future of Billings and ensure the government serves the people. I have five years of experience on City Council and many years before that I’ve participated as a member of the Heights Task Force, serving two years as chair. I’ve established good working relationships with both members of the community and the city staff enabling me to bring issues for consideration and help find solutions.

officials.name: Scott Aspenlieder
officials.address: 316 N. 26th Street Council Chambers, 5th Floor Billings, MT 59101
officials.bio: Scott Aspenlieder was born and raised in Culbertson, Montana, and moved to Billings in 2013 to start Performance Engineering. Scott and his wife, Heather, are happy to be raising their three very active boys in our community. When Scott’s not coaching his son’s sports or attending games he spends his days overseeing landmark projects within the community and managing daily operations of Performance Engineering, as one of its owners and Principal of the firm.

officials.name: Tony O'Donnell
officials.address: 316 N. 26th Street Council Chambers, 5th Floor Billings, MT 59101

officials.name: Mike Nelson
officials.address: 316 N. 26th Street Council Chambers, 5th Floor Billings, MT 59101
officials.bio: Mike Nelson is a proud native of Billings, having graduated from Eastern Montana College with a degree in Economics. After a career in the Hotel/Casino industry in Las Vegas, he returned to Billings in 2008 to refurbish the Northern Hotel and has since been active in community leadership roles, including chairing the Big Sky Economic Development Corporation and the Billings Chamber of Commerce. As Mayor, his priorities include Public Safety, a vibrant economy, and a great quality of life for the Magic City.
